triage.note: PROMOTED FROM HELD-OUT AND BURNED (H1, docs/evals/audits/2026-08-16-h1-heldout-triage.md). The segmenter's load-bearing rule is that a real body heading carries its title on the SAME LINE -- the rule that makes the TOC filter work for free and that ADR-007 records. JNJ 2016 puts the item code and its title in separate markup blocks, so normalization yields 'Item 1.\n\nBUSINESS'. Counted on the normalized text: 18 bare-code heading lines against 3 titled, which is exactly the 18-missing / 3-extracted split the run produced. The discriminator is not merely weakened here, it is INVERTED: the shape that identifies a TOC entry in every dev fixture is the shape of a real body heading in this filing. The T3-T5 cold review named this assumption as the one it would attack next and could not construct a fixture for it; a held-out mega-cap supplied one. Note the failure was LOUD -- 18 expected_item_missing warnings fired -- but doc_status still read success_with_warning, which is a second and separate defect covered by items-stripped-escalation.

provenance: PROMOTED FROM evals/heldout/ after H1 burned it 2026-08-16. The fixture moved from evals/heldout/fixtures/ to evals/fixtures/ unchanged (git mv, byte-identical). MEASURED BEFORE ANY FIX, run 20260816-225101 at git 70d10f1: 3 of 21 items extracted (2, 8 and 16 -- the only three whose title survived in the same block), 18 reported missing, doc_status success_with_warning, and toc_manifest empty so the manifest cross-check had nothing to check against. WHY THESE CHECKS: item_present on 1, 1A, 3, 6, 7 and 16 covers the bare-heading shape across all four Parts rather than one region, so a fix that repairs only the first Part cannot pass. Anchor counts verified 2026-08-16 by direct substring count on the NORMALIZED text (not on the raw file -- grep -c counts matching lines, which reported 1 for a phrase that occurs 7 times): 'which has more than 230 operating companies conducting business' 1x (item 1's opening paragraph), 'Summary of Operations and Statistical Data' 1x (item 6), 'The Company has elected not to include such summary information' 1x (item 16's whole substantive body). min_chars(1, 8000) pins item 1's span as a real section rather than a heading stub. text_not_contains on item 2 guards the bleed direction a naive fix would introduce: if bare headings are promoted without the TOC-cluster rule arbitrating, spans collapse and item 2 swallows Legal Proceedings. Tagged invariant because losing 86% of a mega-cap's items while reporting a qualified success is the silent-failure class the invariant suite exists to make non-negotiable. NOT yet dual-passed by extraction-auditor. PRE-B AUDIT FINDING (2026-08-16, docs/evals/audits/): items 11, 13 and 14 were reported 'extracted' at confidence 0.95 in a doc_status 'success' envelope with zero warnings, and they are pure proxy pointers -- exactly the shape classified 'incorporated_by_reference' in aapl-2025, msft-2013, nvda-2024, nike-2006 and cat-2023. This is failure-taxonomy F3 live on a README-showcased filing at maximum confidence, and it is the class metric 6 reports as 0.0. It is a REGRESSION FROM MY OWN FIXES, compounding two of them: ADR-013 promotes a title from the next line but left heading_end at the end of the bare 'Item 13.' line, so the title text leaked into the body and shifted the sentence boundaries; and ADR-011 tightened the IBR test to require the external-document evidence in the FIRST sentence, which the naive splitter cuts short at the quoted caption “Item 1. Election of Directors”. The original case asserted statuses only for 1, 1A, 3, 6, 7 and 16 and accepted doc_status 'success', so it could not see any of this. | ADR-030 (D3, 2026-08-23): `warning_absent item_dominates` — Item 8 here is 0.5336 of the document ([158429, 360584) of 378,885 chars: the audited financial statements, pages 34–86 of the filing, bounded by the filer's own Item 8 and Item 9 headings), the LARGEST non-last span on any committed real filing, so this case pins the lower edge of ITEM_MAX's measured band (0.5336 here, 0.5723 items-stripped); mutation ITEM_MAX 0.55 -> 0.53 turns this check red (and, through the escalation, the doc_status check: 'ambiguous' not in ['success', 'success_with_warning']). The check is green at origin/main (the code did not exist, so it could not fire) — it is a pin, not a red-first case.
